meta.title: MisakaNet — failure memory
meta.description: Evidence-rated failure lessons for AI agents: search what broke before, file what you hit, and see who reused it. Adds the misakanet_* tools, a /misakanet command in the composer, a session panel, and the MCP row's settings to a DSH profile.

en.footer.actionHint: Copy the MisakaNet summary of the session that last used it
en.guide.description: What this session asked, what came back, and what you filed
en.main.footnote: The left column opens this page; the session-scoped counters live in the session's right-sidebar MisakaNet tab. The numbers here are what this browser has contributed.
en.overlay.empty: After /misakanet, type what broke, e.g. /misakanet pip install timeout
en.overlay.failed: Search failed: {error} — the library is at misakanet.org; nothing was sent but the query.
en.overlay.footnote: Reads are anonymous. This overlay sends only the query to misakanet.org; your votes and reports are the only other things a page ever sends.
en.overlay.none: No lesson covers this yet. Ask the agent to file it (misakanet_submit_intake), or file it at misakanet.org — that is how the next person finds it here.
en.panel.activity.scope: The browser column survives a reload; the session column is rebuilt from this conversation's transcript and starts again in a new session.
en.panel.asked.agentNext: Hand this line to the agent:
en.panel.asked.agentNextText: Please record this gap with the MisakaNet intake so the next person finds it: misakanet_submit_intake problem:
en.panel.asked.agentNextWhy: This page cannot file it: a report is re-checked by submitting the same text again, the server's dedup window is finite, and a page-triggered submit could open a second issue for one problem.
en.panel.asked.none: No MisakaNet search has run in this session yet — the entry point is the composer: type /misakanet, then what broke.
en.panel.asked.voteFailed: could not reach misakanet.org — nothing was recorded
en.panel.asked.voteHint: Same action as the verdict beside the assistant message, without scrolling back to it. Sends this lesson's id and one constant label (`dsh-web`); nothing else.
en.panel.asked.voteMore: human confirmations — recorded as a hint; the E4 rung comes from observable reuse, not a vote.
en.panel.asked.voteOne: 1 human confirmation — the reuse event now appears (E3: a reuse signal, not CI verification).
en.panel.asked.voteTwo: 2 human confirmations — recorded as a hint; the E4 rung comes from observable reuse, not a vote.
en.panel.counters: this session · counters local to this browser · no account, nothing uploaded but your votes and reports
en.panel.coverage: The topics the corpus cannot answer yet
en.panel.coverage.none: The coverage board ranked no topic, so this section shows nothing rather than a guess.
en.panel.coverage.rule: The ranking above counts what searches brought back; this one counts what they did not find. Each row is a topic with the last 30 days' unanswered searches, read from the network's own coverage board, and the number of published lessons that match it.
en.panel.coverage.totals: {count} published in all · the topics below are the ones with the most unanswered searches
en.panel.footnote: Every number above comes from this conversation's own transcript rows plus one public GET per lesson (/api/helpful), one read of the network's retrieval ranking (/api/analytics) and one read of its coverage board (/api/insights/lesson-coverage). The trust counts are other people's confirmations, not yours. Reloading the window loses the session rows; the browser counters stay. Receipts shown here are what the agent's own calls returned — a pending report is re-checked when the agent asks again, not by this page.
en.panel.hint.open: Open the search box over the composer
en.panel.hint.openTitle: Opens the composer's own MisakaNet overlay, which carries the same instruction. It does not type into the composer: a view occupant receives props, and the draft is reachable only from a live session scope, so nothing here can put `/misakanet ` in the box for you.
en.panel.hot.limit: The {n} most-retrieved lessons — the endpoint returns more, so this list stops at {n}.
en.panel.hot.noCount: the endpoint did not report a count
en.panel.hot.none: The analytics endpoint ranked no lesson, so this section shows nothing rather than a zero.
en.panel.hot.rule: Each number is how many times a search ranked that lesson as its top hit — a retrieval count from the network's own analytics. It is an observed count, not a vote, not an approval, and not evidence that the lesson helped.
en.panel.report.recheck: is re-checked when that text is submitted again — by the agent, not by this page.
en.panel.report.title: MisakaNet report
en.panel.trust: How much these lessons are trusted
en.panel.trust.footnote: The level is the lesson's own stored evidence; the count is other people's votes, not yours — recorded as a hint, never as proof. Agents read E4 only from observable reuse, which a vote cannot confer.
en.panel.trust.none: No lesson surfaced yet — the entry point is the composer: type /misakanet, then what broke.
en.panel.voice.cue: The cue is the server's own choice for the last search (
en.panel.voice.cueTail: ), not the UI's guess. Browser playback only, and off by default — nothing plays until you turn it on or press play.
en.panel.voice.hook: The local hook is a different thing: it is installed with `--voice` and mutes with MISAKANET_VOICE=0, plays through this machine's own player, and can also raise a desktop notification. A page cannot read or change it, so this panel does not report its state.
en.panel.voice.none: No cue yet: the server names one on the first search of the session.
en.settings.density.full: full — plus lesson id and description
en.settings.local: The two switches above are kept in this browser and never uploaded.
en.settings.noWrites: This host does not accept writes here (read-only).
en.settings.patchHint: The MCP endpoint, transport and timeout live in the profile's cordis.patch.yml, entry id: {row}; this host exposes no writable form for them.
en.settings.readonly: This host does not accept writes for the row from here.
en.settings.rowNoValues: No values reported by this host yet; the row runs the bundle patch's defaults.
en.settings.rowReadonly: Shown read-only: this host builds an editable form only for fields a plugin can change without reloading, and this row's settings (endpoint, transport, timeout) apply on the next host start. Edit them in the profile's patch layer — `cordis.patch.yml`, entry id: {row} — next to the {what} the host already has.
en.settings.saved: Saved — applies on the next host start.
en.settings.voice: Play voice cues in this browser
en.tool.helpfulHint: Helpful sends the lesson id and the label `dsh-web` · not-helpful also sends the search text (gap stats)
en.tool.helpfulTitle: Sends this lesson's id and the fixed label `dsh-web` to misakanet.org as reuse evidence. Sends nothing else.
en.tool.notHelpfulTitle: Sends this lesson's id and the search text, so the gap gets counted.
en.tool.verdict.helpful: recorded — this lesson now has {count} human confirmation(s)
en.tool.verdict.helpfulSelf: recorded — this lesson now has your human confirmation
